result:
Review complete. Verdict: **approve** (tier1).

I read the standing SUPERBOSS instructions, confirmed no `.github/workflows/**` files are touched, and confirmed the diff doesn't hit any tier2 path patterns (migrations/schema/auth/permission/payment/billing/rls/.env), so the tier1 classification is correct.

For the substance: I hand-traced `mapBoqHeaders` and `mapRowsToLineItems` line-by-line against the exact fixture in the new test (bun wasn't available in this environment to actually execute the suite) and every assertion holds — the priority-order alias fix correctly resolves `Sl No`/`Description (Task)`/`Sub Task`, and the positional parent-inference correctly attaches each block of unlabeled sub-task rows to its preceding task row and resets at the next task. Checked the one real consumer (`src/app/api/construction/boq/import/route.ts`) — it only reads `lineItems`/`warnings`/`totalRows`, unaffected by the new `subTask` field. `computeHierarchicalAmount()` and the DB layer are untouched, matching the stated scope constraint.

Noted two non-blocking issues in the verdict file: I couldn't independently run the test suite (no `bun` binary here), and the positional sub-task-inference heuristic is scoped to this two-level shape and unproven on deeper hierarchies — neither is a defect in what shipped.

Result written to `review-verdict.json`.
